items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: it’s almost like Shakespeare’s “To be or not to be.”

ctx.x: I know it’s a tough one. People ask me the same thing.

This is a very, very complex question, because it’s almost like Shakespeare’s “To be or not to be.” It’s a thing whereas you can answer it, but you’re not really answering the question. You know what I mean. It’s like a quest to get a more beautiful sound. What you’re really trying to do – I know it doesn’t come off this way – but you’re trying to get it to be glorious, which to me is the greatest a sound can get. It can be beautiful, ethereal, but if you can get it to be glorious, it means it is expanding, or it…
Do you mean glorious on a spiritual level, like heavenly? I don’t know what you mean by glorious.
